errors.evidence: In the description of the second graph (Heston model simulation), the starting value is stated to be 'a little above 60'. However, the graph clearly shows the line starting at a value of approximately 105.

In the description of the second graph, the line is said to decrease to 'around 80'. The graph shows the line ending at a value just below 90 (approximately 88). A value of 'around 80' is a significant underestimation and more than a full grid line away from the actual final value.

The description treats the two graphs as separate entities and fails to mention the overall purpose of the figure, which is to compare the real price data of Brent crude oil with a simulated price trajectory from the Heston model. This comparative aspect is crucial for understanding the figure as a whole.
